title: The Beginning Comes Suddenly
overview: Nanoha is ambushed by Vita for her Linker Core.

title: Once Again, the Storms of Battle
overview: Nanoha and Fate fight the much stronger Wolkenritter.

title: Reunion and Relocation!
overview: Raising Heart and Bardiche demand a new and dangerous modification to their design.

title: New Power, Start!
overview: Hayate's condition worsens, and the TSAB corner the Wolkenritter.

title: It Was a Small Wish (Part One)
overview: A masked man appears to help the Wolkenritter, whose artificial nature is revealed.

title: It Was a Small Wish (Part Two)
overview: Hayate's love has given the Wolkenritter emotion, and though she says not to hurt anyone, they ignore this in order to protect her.

title: With the Broken Past and Present
overview: Fate and Nanoha again confront Signum and Vita, trying to get them to open up.

title: A Tragic Resolve Is the Courageous Decision!
overview: Nanoha and Fate meet Hayate, and the TSAB realize that the Book of Darkness is going to kill her.

title: Christmas Eve
overview: While Chrono researches Graham, the masked man- well, two of him- complete the Book of Darkness at great cost and frame Nanoha and Fate for the crime.

title: Destiny
overview: Hayate is engulfed by the Book's power. Chrono confronts Graham on the past and gets a new weapon.

title: A Gift for Christmas Eve
overview: Fate faces her dreams up against reality, while Nanoha battles the Book of Darkness.

title: Night's End, Journey's End
overview: Wolkenritter, Nanoha, Fate, Hayate and TSAB alike team up against the final enemy.

title: Stand By. Ready.
overview: Although the danger is averted, the threat to Hayate's life remains. In view of this, Reinforce makes a fateful choice.
